content: {"receiving_body":"fixture:body:voice","claims":[{"text":"The person was Mara Ibarra, displayed as Mara, with login mara-river and account ID 1847.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Her suggestion appeared in HarborMesh issue 47 at https://forge.example.invalid/commons/harbormesh/issues/47.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"identification"},{"text":"Forge's issue comments reached our code body on 2026-04-14; Mara's proposal in comment c901 was dated 2026-04-12.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"context"},{"text":"She proposed a local replay queue to preserve readings through outages on disconnected relay nodes.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"The proposal retained the existing scheduler.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"meaning"},{"text":"Mara and our code body agreed to prototype it in comment c906 on 2026-04-14.","support":[1],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"A human report received through our code body on 2026-05-03 said the April 30 trial replayed buffered readings correctly through an outage.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"That report said wider rollout paused on May 2 pending understanding of calibration drift.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"outcome"},{"text":"As of the 2026-05-03 report, there was no production deployment; the supplied memories do not establish the project's current state.","support":[3],"basis":"memory","facet":"limits"}]}
